title: Chapter 196
text:
The players in this novice village were almost all harvested. Han Xiao counted his experience happily. It was another big harvest.

However, until now, no one had come to buy the recommendation letter. But Grand Duke Han was not arrogant and was very patient. The news of him releasing the main storyline mission had caused a huge commotion on the forum. Sooner or later, someone would take the bait.

"There's only one novice village left. Maybe I should drag it out and give those big guilds time to raise money," Han Xiaoxin said.

At this time, two players approached together. Their IDs were Windchaser and Dragon Tail, and they attracted the attention of the surrounding players. They were players from the Nine Gates Club and the Fanatics Club, and they were quite famous.

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. Finally, the pro players were here.

"Black Phantom, we want to buy the recommendation letter," Windchaser said.

"Okay."

Windchaser and Dragon Tail were sponsored by the guilds under the clubs. A team was the face of a club, and as professional players, they had this privilege. The two of them took out 250,000 each.

The surrounding players craned their necks and looked envious. They had never seen such a huge amount of money before.

"There are actually people who can afford it."

"The big guilds are really rich."

"No wonder the pro players are better than us. If I had such resources, I could be a pro player too."

"You think just anyone can sign a contract with a club?"

A player suddenly had an idea. "We'll be rich if we steal their money."

"Don't be stupid. Not to mention that the pro players can kill you, even if you really get it, the guilds will definitely chase you to the ends of the earth. Maybe Black Phantom will kill you first."

Everyone was discussing.

With 500,000 in his account, he wrote the recommendation letter on the spot and handed it to the two pro players. Han Xiao told them about a Dark Net stronghold in the Western Continent and said, "… You can join the Blood Pact Society if you bring my letter there."

He paused and said, "I seem to be able to trust you. There are some jobs here. Are you willing to help?"

"That's what I'm waiting for." Dragon Tail could not wait to accept the mission. After accepting one, he wanted to accept another, but he was notified that he could only accept one mission in the series and could not accept other missions at the same time.

This was set by Han Xiao. One recommendation letter for one mission.

"F * ck, I can only accept one quest. I thought I could accept all the quests." Ferocious Dragon Swings Its Tail was dissatisfied.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and said indifferently. "It's fine if you don't want to do it."

Ferocious Dragon Swings Its Tail immediately shut up. If he didn't accept the mission, wouldn't he be wasting his money?

Windchaser could only helplessly choose the same mission. The two clubs cooperated and formed a team to complete the mission. Fortunately, the Mighty Dragon Swings Its Tail mission was in the West Continent.

"If you can complete this mission, I might have more things that I need your help with." Han Xiao hinted that if he wanted to unlock his' hidden storyline ', he had to complete this mission first.

The professional players raced against time and left immediately after receiving the mission.

Of the five mission targets, two were in the West Continent, two were in the North Continent, and one was in the South Continent. He had to make sure that someone would accept all of them. It just so happened that all three continents were on his itinerary.

Although the Main Mission was of A-rank difficulty, this was only the first part of the Mission. Han Xiao separated the Main Mission into small missions of D-rank difficulty. He could afford it with the amount of experience he gave out.

"When the difficulty gets higher in the later parts, I might not have enough experience points." Han Xiao felt that he needed a channel to increase his experience points. There was no hope for him to level up now, so he could only start from the faction and legendary level.

"Windchaser and Mighty Dragon Swings Its Tail are normal professional players. They didn't seem to have a particularly good battle record in my previous life. I'll observe them for now." Han Xiao was very strict with his choice of backups. He didn't pull them in every time he saw a professional player.

…

Fanatics and Nine Gates announced that their players had bought the recommendation letter on the forum. It was equivalent to advertising and increasing the fame of their clubs. Many players were watching and cheering for them.

Because of the advertisements of the two clubs, Han Xiao had also indirectly gained fame. It was conceivable that in the future, the clubs that bought the recommendation letters would follow suit, and Han Xiao estimated that he would gain fame on the forums many times.

Without stopping, Han Xiao came to the last novice village in the Western Continent. While harvesting experience points, there were also new professional players who squandered their guild's wealth in exchange for the opportunity to accept missions. The ordinary players could only watch with envy.

The other Main Mission in the Western Continent was also accepted by a professional player. Han Xiao was finally relieved. He leisurely sold his skills and paid attention to the forum and dark web.

"Hey, Galaxy Times has published a new issue. The subtitle is … Pro League Formation?"

Han Xiao was excited. He had been paying attention to this program and immediately clicked on it.

"Hello, players," the male host said. "This is Galaxy Times, dedicated to sharing first-hand game information and protecting your gaming career."

"Xiao Chun, I've been very anxious recently," the female host said.

"What's wrong, Qiuqiu?"

"I've fallen in love with a man. He doesn't talk much, and he's handsome. He's cold and aloof, but he never looks at me or talks to me."

"Don't worry, I think you're a perfect match for him."

The female host was pleasantly surprised. "Really?"

"Of course, he's cold and aloof, and you're short and hot. It's a perfect match."

"…"

It was the same awkward joke at the beginning of every episode. This style made Han Xiao feel so familiar with it that he almost peed his pants.

The bullet screen was filled with ridicule and ridicule.

There were many players who watched Galaxy Times. It had been less than a month since it started broadcasting, and it had already become an authoritative program in the eyes of the players. After all, it had an official background and had a lot of first-hand information.

After chatting for a while to liven up the atmosphere, the male host said, "Okay, let's get back to the topic. Today's program will analyze the hottest Inhuman phenomenon and the movements of the professional players. We also invited Li Ge to the studio. Don't leave."

The content of the program was still very detailed. At the beginning, it went through the current progress of the players on each planet and commented on the level rankings.

"… Now, among the players, the highest leveled vanguard is approaching the Level 20 mark. Level 20 will be the first advancement. I don't know who will get this honor, but the first player to successfully advance will be recorded in the history of the game."

"Then, as you can clearly see, among the players at the top of the level rankings, there are basically no professional players. Among them, there are the most Japanese players. As everyone knows, Japan's base is Planet Loni, where technology and magic coexist. The crystal civilization is at its peak, and it's very suitable to take on missions to level up. France and America also have a lot of players, but there are not many Chinese players on the list. Oh, I saw an old acquaintance, Maple Moon. You remember her, right? When the open beta started, she received more than 100,000 EXP. That was also the first prize-pool mission that all the players had encountered so far.

"Speaking of Black Phantom, he has been attracting the attention of the players on Planet Aquamarine since the beginning of the game. Recently, there have been new developments. He has been appearing in the newbie village to provide guidance and benefits. Not long ago, he showed another main storyline mission, and the prerequisite is an extremely expensive item worth 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars! If players from other planets want to understand the concept of price, you can go to the exchange rate board and see the amount of resources that can be exchanged for 250,000 Aquamarine Dollars.
